sentence.sentence: With a minimum follow-up of 10 years, median overall survival was 71.9 months with nivolumab plus ipilimumab, 36.9 months with nivolumab, and 19.9 months with ipilimumab.
sentence.title: Final, 10-Year Outcomes with Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab in Advanced Melanoma.

items.rationale: 十年结果分别保留联合、纳武利尤单药、伊匹木单药OS，未将联合结果当单药。
